name: Tea shop
description: A small online tea shop: a seasonal hero, a product grid with filter chips and quick add, a product page with a gallery, a brewing guide on a dial and a steep timer, and a cart drawer that ends in a printed receipt.

props.name: image
props.description: Returns a picture for a key: a tea id for its main picture, "<id>:farm" and "<id>:liquor" for the gallery, and "hero" for the backdrop of the seasonal banner. Tea pictures are tinted to the colour of the tea. Without it, quiet placeholders show.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root. It is at least the height of the viewport and the page scrolls. Also accepts every other div attribute.
